classification.difficultyReason: Choose two different pairs of dimensions for each given area and construct the corresponding rectangles.

content.prompt: For each part below, draw two different rectangles with the given area.

answer.short: Sample answers: $6\text{ cm}\times1.5\text{ cm}$ and $3\text{ cm}\times3\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Choose two different pairs of lengths whose products are $9$.

$$\begin{align*}A_1&=6\times1.5\\A_1&=9\text{ cm}^2\\A_2&=3\times3\\A_2&=9\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

A square is also a rectangle.

spec.description: Two authored sample rectangles, one 6 cm by 1.5 cm and one square 3 cm by 3 cm, drawn at a common scale.
